C. & S. B. REGT /
No. D /
Date ____ /

Chapei Police
functioning in
the Fong Loh Li
off North Sze-
chuen Road.

At 6.30 p.m. 18-10-33, Sub Inspector Yung Ping
attached to the 5th Division Headquarters, Paoshan
Road, came to Dixwell Road Station and reported that
owing to a dispute between certain tenants residing
in the Fong Loh Li off North Szechuen Road and the
China Realty Co. over the irregular functioning
of water supply, they had detailed two constables
from 5th Division Headquarters to patrol the alleyway.

Officer in charge of district visited the above
headquarters, but found that officer in charge was
gone out. The above mentioned Sub-Inspector was
present and it was explained to him that Fong Loh Li
was policed by the Dixwell Road Station and by placing
their own police there they had to function from
the municipal roadway.

The Chapei Police to function in this particular
alleyway, have to cross either the North Szechuen
Road or the Darroch Road which are Municipal Roads.

He stated that he could not issue any orders for
their withdrawal and that they would only be there
temporarily.

So the matter was left in abeyance till the
19-10-33. None of these residents pay S.M.C. taxes.
Capt. Kennedy D.O. "C" informed.

For full details see Dixwell Road Misc. 95/33.

Officer in charge accompanied by Inspector

上海公共租界工部局警务处
C. & S. B. 团 /
编号 D /
日期 ____ /

闸北警察
在四川北路旁的
丰乐里
执行职务。

1933年10月18日下午6时30分，隶属于宝山路第五分区总部的副督察荣平（Yung Ping，音译）来到狄思威路捕房报告称，由于居住在四川北路旁丰乐里的某些租户与中国地产公司（China Realty Co.）之间因供水不正常而发生纠纷，他们已派遣两名来自第五分区总部的警员在该弄堂巡逻。

辖区负责人前往上述总部，但发现负责人已外出。上述副督察在场，向他解释说，丰乐里由狄思威路捕房负责警务，他们将自己的警察部署在那里，就必须从市政道路进入执行职务。

闸北警察若要在这个特定的弄堂执行职务，必须穿越四川北路或达罗克路（Darroch Road），这两条都是市政道路。

他表示，他无法下达撤出命令，并称他们只是暂时停留在那里。

因此，此事被搁置至1933年10月19日。这些居民均不缴纳工部局捐税。已通知“C”区值班官肯尼迪上尉（Capt. Kennedy）。

详细情况见狄思威路杂项档案 95/33。

1933年10月18日上午11时15分，第81号巡长伯特（Burt）在捕房报告称，他收到第22号华捕的报告，称中国当局正在四川北路旁的木兰别墅18号进行逮捕行动。

辖区负责人在伊娃督察（Inspector Eva）和白副督察（P.S.I. White）的陪同下，立即前往上述地址，并查明了以下信息：-

副督察，
请保留此件，
用于编制月度报告。

Acting on instructions from Nanking, Wong Vung
Tsing, attached to the Public Safety Bureau, accom-
panied by two other officers had visited the Foreign
Language College, No.18-19 Magnolia Terrace, and
arrested one named Zung Pih Tien, age 26, native of
Anhwei, treasurer of the above College and Dean of the
New Asia Middle School, situated at 135 North
Szechuen Road, suspected of being a member of a
Communist organization.

He stated that he understood that the Terrace
in question was in Chinese Territory and therefore
had failed to obtain a warrant and also did not
think it necessary to obtain assistance from the
S.M.P.

A search of the premises failed to reveal any
communistic documents.

Officer in charge communicated with Capt, Kennedy
D.U. "C" **〔此处转录不清〕** who subsequently gave instructions for
the arrested person to be handed over to the Bureau
of Public Safety.

These instructions were complied with. Mr.
Givens (A.C. S.B.) informed. Officer in charge of
district proceeded to 5th Division Headquarters
Paoshan Road where the arrested person was taken
and lodged a formal protest to the officer in charge
re failing to obtain the necessary assistance from
Dixwell Road Station. He stated that the Detectives
had made the arrest without his knowledge and he
would try and avoid any such incident in future.

The Magnolia Terrace is policed by the
Municipal Police from Dixwell Road Station and prior
to the trouble. the Chapei Police had no access to
the Terrace unless they entered same from the

4543 /
Dixwell Road. Station
REPORT
Date 18/10/33. 19

Subject (in full) Arrest of an alleged Communist in Magnolia Terrace, off
North Szechuen Road, by members of the P.S.Bureau.

Made by ____ and Forwarded by D.S.I. White.

Sir,
At 11.15 a.m. the 18/10/33, F.S.81 Burt came to Dixwell Rd.
Station and reported that whilst patrolling North Szechuen Road
at about 11.5 a.m. even date, he was informed by J.P.C.92 that a
Chinese youth had approached him and stated that a foreigner in
Magnolia Terrace, off N. Szechuen Road, and instructed him to
obtain the services of a Foreign Police Officer. On receipt of
this information F.S.81 Burt and J.P.C.92 entered Magnolia Terrace,
where they encountered a Mr. Ritchie, Portuguese, a teacher of the
Foreign Language College, No.18/19 Magnolia Terrace. Mr. Ritchie
Informed F.S. Burt that three male Chinese, stated to be detectives
attached to the Public Safety Bureau, had entered No.18 Magnolia
Terrace and effected the arrest of one of the principals of the
school. These detectives on being questioned and requested to pro-
duce judicial documentary evidence to justify the arrest, failed
to do so, and, Mr. Ritchie was of the opinion that the procedure was
not in order.

On receipt of the aforesaid report, Inspector Shellswell,
D.S.I.White and D.S.I. Zong Woo proceeded to No.18 Magnolia Terrace,
where the aforementioned police officers encountered a detective
named. Wong Yung Tsing (王文俊), attached to the Public Safety Bureau
Headquarters, who was accompanied by two companions. These detec-
tives had effected the arrest of Zung Pin Tien (程秉天), aged 26 yrs.,
native of Anhwei, treasurer of the Foreign Language College, and
Dean of the New Asia Middle School, 135 A, N. Szechuen Road.
Detective Wong Yung Tsing (王文俊), P.S. Bureau, stated that they
were acting on instructions received from Nanking to effect that
Zung Pin Tien (程秉天), is a member of a communistic organisation
and requesting that he be apprehended. Believing that Magnolia

主题（全称） 公安局人员在四川北路旁木兰别墅逮捕一名涉嫌共产党人。

由 ____ 制作，由白副督察（D.S.I. White）转发。

先生，
1933年10月18日上午11时15分，第81号外勤警员（F.S.81）伯特来到狄思威路捕房报告称，同日约上午11时05分，他在四川北路巡逻时，第92号华捕（J.P.C.92）告知他，有一名中国青年走近他，称四川北路旁木兰别墅的一名外国人指示他去寻求一名外籍警官的服务。收到此信息后，第81号外勤警员伯特和第92号华捕进入木兰别墅，在那里遇到了一位葡萄牙籍男子里奇先生（Mr. Ritchie），他是木兰别墅18/19号外国语学院的教师。里奇先生告知伯特外勤警员，三名自称隶属于公安局的男探员进入了木兰别墅18号，并逮捕了该校的一位主要负责人。当这些探员被质问并被要求出示证明逮捕正当性的司法文件证据时，他们未能做到，里奇先生认为该程序不合规范。

收到上述报告后，谢尔斯韦尔督察（Inspector Shellswell）、白副督察（D.S.I. White）和宗伍副督察（D.S.I. Zong Woo，音译）前往木兰别墅18号，上述警务人员在那里遇到了一名隶属于公安局总部的名叫王文俊（Wong Yung Tsing）的探员，他由两名同伴陪同。这些探员逮捕了程秉天（Zung Pin Tien），现年26岁，安徽籍，外国语学院财务主管及四川北路135 A号新亚中学校长。公安局探员王文俊表示，他们是根据从南京收到的指令行事，称程秉天是共产党组织的成员，并要求将其逮捕。相信木兰

Terrace was under Chinese jurisdiction they had failed to obtain
a warrant and had officiated without the usual formality of notifying
the Municipal Police. This detective further admitted that they
did not possess any incriminating evidence or statement implicating
the arrested man, but were merely acting on instructions received
from Nanking. A search of the premises failed to disclose any
communistic documents or other incriminating evidence on the pre-
mises. Inspector Shellswell communicated with Capt. Kennedy, D.
O. "C", who subsequently gave instructions for the arrested man to
be handed over to the Public Safety Bureau, which instructions
were complied with, without the accused being brought to Dixwell
Road Station. Mr. Givens, A.C.(S.B.) was also informed of the
incident by the Officer i/c District. The scene of the incident,
Magnolia Terrace, is actually located in Chinese Territory, but
being inaccessible to the Chapei Police, is therefore patrolled
by Municipal Police. No residents of these premises pay S.M.C.
taxes, but Chinese residents pay taxes to the Chinese Authorities.
Subsequently, Inspector Shellswell visited 5th Div. Hqrs., P.S.
Bureau and made a protest to the Inspector i/c regarding the breach
of usual formalities, in not informing Dixwell Road Station of the
intended arrest, and was assured that the detectives from Nanking
had functioned without the knowledge of the Inspector i/c, and,
that no incident would arise in future to give cause for complaint.

（左侧手写批注：The officer who confirms to me and that Magnolia Terrace is accessible from Chinese controlled territory and actually that this had come about through house on the Chinese side having been destroyed during the Sino-Japanese incident. JWS）
（左下角手写批注：28/10 Lctd by ...）

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
R. J. White

Officer i/c. S. B.
D.S.I.

别墅处于中国管辖之下，他们未能取得搜查令，且未按惯例通知市政警察便执行了公务。该探员进一步承认，他们没有任何牵连被捕者的罪证或供词，仅仅是根据从南京收到的指令行事。对住所的搜查未在任何场所发现任何共产主义文件或其他罪证。谢尔斯韦尔督察与“C”区值班官肯尼迪上尉（Capt. Kennedy）取得联系，后者随后指示将被捕者移交给公安局，该指示已得到执行，被告未被带至狄思威路捕房。辖区负责人也将此事通知了助理总监（特别分部）吉文斯先生（Mr. Givens, A.C.(S.B.)）。事发地点木兰别墅实际上位于中国领土内，但由于闸北警察无法进入，因此由市政警察巡逻。这些住所的居民不缴纳工部局捐税，但中国居民向中国当局纳税。随后，谢尔斯韦尔督察访问了第五分区总部及公安局，就未按惯例通知狄思威路捕房拟进行的逮捕行动这一违反常规程序的行为，向主管督察提出抗议，并得到保证称，来自南京的侦探是在主管督察不知情的情况下行动的，今后不会发生引起投诉的事件。

（左侧手写批注：向我确认的警官指出，木兰别墅可从中国控制的领土进入，实际上这是因为在中日事变期间，中方一侧的房屋被毁所致。JWS）
（左下角手写批注：10月28日 由 ... 阅毕）

此致，
敬礼，
R. J. 怀特

特别分部主管
副督察
